title: Egg video as helicopter sling load

tellings.quote: I think it's probably something larger. I think it might actually be from a helicopter and it might be something being moved.

plain: A 2025 video of an egg-shaped object, which the journalist Ross Coulthart and a man named Jake Barber present as a mysterious craft, may really show something hanging under a helicopter, according to the UFO skeptic Mick West. West says the object is probably bigger than it looks and might be a load being moved by helicopter. This is his own reading of the footage, and it would mean the video shows nothing unusual.
